name: Samarth Elder Care – Mumbai
description:
At Samarth Elder Care and Community, we provide trusted elder care services in Mumbai, helping families ensure their parents live safely, comfortably, and with dignity at home. Our compassionate caregivers deliver personalized support for health, companionship, and daily needs across Andheri, Powai, Bandra, Borivali, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Dadar, and South Mumbai, as well as nearby suburbs.

Backed by Samarth Life Management Private Limited, we combine compassionate service with smart technology to deliver dignified, personalized care for seniors. Choose Samarth for reliable, professional, and heartfelt home care for the elderly in Mumbai you can trust.

owner_posts.post_text: At Samarth Eldercare, we believe healthy ageing begins with informed choices. Watch this video to learn practical tips that can help seniors stay active, maintain independence, and embrace healthier ageing every day.

Discover how scrapbooking can become a joyful and meaningful activity for older adults. From keeping the mind active to revisiting cherished memories, this simple creative practice offers both relaxation and emotional connection.

Encourage your loved ones to explore a hobby that not only sparks creativity but also brings a sense of fulfillment and happiness.

✨ Read now to see how scrapbooking can support mental well-being and create moments of joy every day.

Discover eco-friendly home cooling ideas specially helpful for older adults. Learn simple ways to keep indoor spaces comfortable, reduce heat, and save energy while supporting a healthier and more sustainable living environment.

Stay active, stay balanced, and stay independent 🧘‍♀️

Join our beginner-friendly yoga session specially designed for seniors. The session focuses on gentle stretches, simple movements, and guided support to help improve flexibility, balance, and overall well-being in a safe environment.

Take a step toward better health and an active lifestyle.

Support Clearer Vision with the Right Nutrition

Healthy eyes need the right nutrients—especially as we age. Learn how specific vitamins and minerals can help protect eye health, support clearer vision, and maintain comfort over time.

A helpful read for seniors and families looking to take simple, proactive steps toward better eye care.

A Nourishing Protein Drink for Older Adults

We recommend this protein drink as a simple and effective way to support muscle strength, recovery, and overall vitality in older adults. Rich in essential nutrients, it helps maintain energy levels and encourages active, independent living.

An easy addition to daily nutrition that supports strength and well-being at every age.

A Walking Stick Designed for Safety & Comfort

We recommend this adjustable walking stick for its thoughtful design that supports confidence and independence in older adults. With a stable base for better balance, built-in LED lights for visibility, and a lightweight, foldable build, it’s easy to use both indoors and outdoors.

A practical mobility aid that helps seniors move safely and comfortably every day.

Smart Money Management for Seniors

Financial confidence plays an important role in independent and stress-free living. This guide shares practical money-management strategies that help seniors stay prepared, organised, and in control of their everyday finances.

A helpful read for seniors and families looking to plan ahead with confidence.

Ageing Doesn’t Have to Mean Slowing Down

Staying active and healthy is possible at every age. In this video, we explain how nitric acid supports blood circulation and essential body functions, and when its use may be recommended for older adults.

A simple, informative watch for seniors and caregivers looking to understand everyday health better.

🎥 Watch the video to learn more.

featured_reviews.name: Monalisa Irani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am working as care counsellor in Samarth.  Samarth is taking care of seniors as their own parents.  We care counsellors considering ourselves as daughter of them and taking upmost care.

This work gives me satisfaction and now I am without parents so when I am meeting my Samarth parents I get feeling of mayka and even they treat me as their child.

Thanks Samarth 😍

featured_reviews.name: Shilky Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Being a part of Samarth Elder Care has been a truly meaningful and fulfilling experience for me. Working as a Care Counsellor gives me a deep sense of purpose, as I am able to support elders and understand their needs closely. The trust that seniors and their families place in us motivates every day. I really appreciate the positive and encouraging work culture at Samarth. The team is supportive and always ready to guide whenever required. The training sessions  improves my skills and give me practical learning and better understanding of how to support elders effectively.  Every visit  brings new learning and growth for me. I am genuinely happy to be part of the Samarth family and look forward to continuing this journey with dedication.

featured_reviews.name: Panna Rajgor
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm a teacher by profession and always had it in my mind to be helpful to others especially elders and specially abled people. I got the  opportunity to be a part of Samarth and it changed my life for good. I started looking at life differently, more positive outlook towards life and I saw growth in my own mental and emotional health. Being a part of Samarth has made me value each and everyday and made me a better person. THANKYOU team Samarth Elder care

featured_reviews.name: Manjusha Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice n quite location in Mumbai makes the stay for any patient at Dr. Waghs home for aged very comfortable. My father's stay for 3 months there was a good experience March to June 2025....Dr Niranjan Wagh and Sumangala Wagh and their staff n caretakers have taken good care of my father....good, tasty nutrious food prepared by Mrs  Wagh is one of the highlight along with professional staff keeping patients and premises clean...My father had some leg injury which was taken good care of by calling doctor n keeping me informed on daily basis about progress n dressing...I am  greatful to everyone there for running this home for aged with love, care and hygine.... featured_reviews.name: Prakash Divekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I want to express my heartfelt gratitude for the good  care  my mother(age 95 years)  received during her (almost  two‑years)  stay at DR. WAGH'S HOME FOR THE AGED.
From the moment we arrived, Dr. Niranjan. M. Wagh and Mrs Wagh as also the staff greeted us with warmth and professionalism, making us  feel comfortable. From day one, the staff (nurse, caregivers etc) made my mother  feel at home with their warm smiles, gentle attentiveness, compassion, support. They always took the time to sit and chat, turning ordinary moments into wondetful memories.
Dr Wagh himself visits daily(evening) for health checkup.  Mrs Wagh herself prepares most of the food, breakfast, special dish on festivals etc and serves (breakfast, lunch, fruits, dinner) everyone on the right time. The staff  kept my mother clean and maintained her higiene.
All  visitors are treated with courtesy  by the staff as also the relatives are provided with relevant details regarding their loved one’s condition or specific needs and medication, if any.
The facility is clean, safe, and well maintained, creating a comfortable environment that felt more like a family home than a care center.
Thanks to Dr Wagh and Mrs Wagh as also  the staff ( nurse, aaya, caregivers etc) as we had peace of mind knowing my mother  was in the best possible hands.

Prakash S Divekar and family

featured_reviews.name: rahul trivedi
featured_reviews.review_text: My grandmother was admitted here post hospitalisation for post hospitalisation care. We are very satisfied with the treatment and care provided by Dr Niranjan Wagh and Mrs Wagh as well as the support staff Mr Santosh and Ms Sangita. I will definitely recommend this place to whoever is looking out for care of the elderly.

featured_reviews.name: Samir Bhagwat
featured_reviews.review_text: My mother is living here since past 3 years. I live outside India. My relatives in India and I are able to video call during “visitation” times. I visit in-person when I’m in Mumbai. The location is nice in Jogeshwari East. The staff is very caring and dedicated. I know most of the staff well and they know my family. Dr. Niranjan Wagh and Mrs. Sumangala Wagh personally check on my mother and communicate with me as needed. Recently my mother had femur fracture due to osteoporosis which needed to be treated by orthopedic surgery. Dr and Mrs. Wagh and the staff coordinated logistics and communication with Orthopedic Surgeon, as well as with my aunt and uncle. I was able to be present post-surgery for discharge. Now, the staff is providing needed extra care. I appreciate the care and comfort they provide.

featured_reviews.name: Supriya Advikolanu
featured_reviews.review_text: I had kept my mother in Dr Wagh's Home for the Aged, for the last 4 months. Have just got her back home because I found a good caretaker for her. Her stay at Dr Wagh's Home was extremely pleasant. Not only Dr Wagh and Mrs Sumangala Wagh , but even their care taking staff is extremely compassionate and understanding. My mother was kept very clean and was very very well looked after. Heartfelt Thanks to each and every one at this Home.

featured_reviews.name: Salil Choksi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Well located in a quiet area within Mumbai. Most rooms have good ventilation.
Dr Wagh personally checks every patient daily.
The nurse and support staff take good care of the residents.
Food is nutritious and tasty.
Costs are reasonable.
Good place to admit senior citizens temporarily when the rest of family travels.

featured_reviews.name: sheetal potdar
featured_reviews.review_text: My mom was in the hospice care with Dr wagh home for the aged for her last few months. We had a unique situation where she was bed ridden whereas I was living outside india. My mom was in a critical condition for a prolonged time. It was an emotionally difficult decision however Dr Wagh promised me that he will take care of her and I do not have to worry. He and Mrs Wagh and their whole staff used to provide me all the small details about her condition through video call and phone. They lived up to their promise while she was with them. Their facility is also kept very clean and hygienic. Their staff is also very polite and caring. Because of Mr & Mrs Wagh and their whole staff (who was also very caring like them) I was able to be rest assured that she was very well taken care off. Their nurses and them both were in touch with me on a daily basis and helped me be sane in those last critical days of her life. Therefore I strongly recommend Mr&Mrs Wagh home for the aged for anyone who is in a similar situation like me or if there is a need for anyone to have the best possible care for their aged family members whom they are  unable to take care of due to unavoidable circumstances.

featured_reviews.name: jayesh gadhave
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have taken service from Mahesh Malvade of patient care for my father. He himself is a caretake and when he talks it seems he has worked as wardboy. He has worked at my house for few day in the last week of January 2025 till 1st week of Feb 2025.
1. While attending the patient his priority is to answer calls on phone. He left the exercise which was to be done for my fater in middle and kept answers calls of future customers. On asking, he never listens to patient or the person who has hired him. He says customer is important even though he is infront of his customer.
2. I wrote down everything for him so that he does everything timely. Like medication and exercises to be done for patient. Later he told me that he doesn't understands English. I felt like I have hired a wrong guy. When he told he can do work of nurse, I thought he should be able to follow few basic english. I had to translate everything for him in Marathi. He didn't agree to take efforts in writing down in a language he understands. I had to do it for him.
3. Even after writing down everything for him, He never reads and makes mistakes.
4. He doesn't understands what the patient is going through and how to talk with patient. One the very first day of his duty in first 15 mins he kept talking about his life problems.
5. He will never let you speak: He has a habit of breaking the conversation and not listen to anything told to him. I had to train him myself for small small things which even a child could have learnt in 2 days.
6. He mentions that he has experience of 15 years but in reality it doesn't reflects. While talking with him he mistakenly told me that he is into patient care since 2 years. So his claim of 15 years is not to be trusted. I did a mistake of beliving in him.
7. He know how to waste time: Before coming inside the house he will mark his attandance by writing a whatsapp message. But then he will go to washroom, later wash hands and gargal and change cloths. He will ask of tea, breakfast and vegitable for lunch, etc. I have made tea for him along even though I was doing my office work thinking he is taking care of my father. He will go to Washroom so frequently that you will think if there is some problem in his kidney.
8. I though he will become friendly with patient and get along but that never happened.
9. He said it takes more that 2 hours for him to reach my house but when he wanted to take a leave, he just informed me 20 mins before. Once he came late by 1 hour without informing. he wrote me when he was outside my door and started arguing with me even though it was his mistake.
10. He is not a nurse: Don't give any work to him that a qualified person should do, you will regret.
11. From the very first day he kept telling me that I can trust him and leave to office. He says many people kepts trust on him and left home when he was along. But the mistakes his is doing even in our presence are not acceptable. How can we leave the home if he is doing these many mistake?
12. He himself is a caretaker and runs his business of agency. My experience with him was not good at all and I will not recommend his service if your loved once need critical care.

Nice place for senior citizens who are left there by their own kids. Feels very bad to look at those old faces who are not happy there. If you visit please do not ask them about their family as it might make them emotional.

featured_reviews.review_text: Very nice place and the people are also very nice. The staff really try to help the aged in all the ways they can. All in all, they are doing a remarkable job and it really is an eye opening experience.

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came across The Wisdom Club while searching for reliable assisted living facilities in Mumbai, and choosing it for my mother’s post-surgery recovery turned out to be one of the best decisions we made. From day one, the care felt thoughtful and reassuring.
The doctors were attentive, and the physiotherapy support, especially from Dr. Manasa - was outstanding. She was patient, encouraging and extremely knowledgeable, which made a huge difference to my mother’s recovery. Her progress was rapid and far better than we had expected.
What really stood out was how closely the team monitored her health while still making her feel comfortable and at home. As a family, it gave us immense peace of mind knowing she was in safe and capable hands. I would highly recommend The Wisdom Club to anyone looking for quality service of elder care in Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: Jocelyn Gopal Pacheco
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosing a place for my parent was one of the hardest decisions I've had to make, but The Wisdom Club has been a total blessing.

The central location is also a huge plus, making it so easy for me to drop by and visit regularly.

The first thing you notice is how clean and peaceful it feels and it’s got a genuine warmth.

What first gave us peace of mind were the pre-joining meetings with Dr. Prem n Dr Manasa who were so sincere and they wanted to learn about my parent’s personal life story and our specific situation, not just the medical numbers. That level of care is rare.

The daily curated activities keep the atmosphere lively, and the food is a real standout with the Maharaj who prepares simple, tasty, home-cooked meals making it feel so much more personal.

The staff are also incredible, so patient and always smiling even at busy times but a special shout-out to Seema! Her bubbly nature adds so much life and joy to the place.

It is such a relief to see my parent treated with this much love and dignity & just so grateful to have found this place and highly recommend  The Wisdom club to anyone looking for elder care in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
My father stayed at The Wisdom Club for a month after his hip surgery. He had suffered a fall and needed to be admitted to the hospital immediately. One of the best decisions we made was bringing him to The Wisdom Club post his surgery.

The atmosphere there truly sped up his recovery. It was calm, positive and reassuring in every way. A big thank you to Dr. Prem and Dr. Manasa, along with the wonderful caregiving and nursing staff, for their constant care and support. The Wisdom Club truly stands apart and, in my experience, beats any nursing home facility or setup. Deeply grateful for the care my father received here!

featured_reviews.name: PRATIKSHA BANE
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took my mother to The Wisdom Club for physiotherapy sessions, and the experience has been wonderful. The sessions never felt like a “task”. They were engaging and even fun. Dr. Manasa has a rare ability to keep patients motivated while seamlessly ensuring that all the required exercises are covered.

My mother earlier struggled to stay consistent with physiotherapy, but here she continued her sessions regularly and showed rapid improvement in her mobility. She is now able to walk better and feels much more confident in her movement.

Kudos to the entire team at The Wisdom Club for the care, encouragement and for keeping such a positive environment. Highly recommended for physiotherapy and elder care.

featured_reviews.name: Steffi Evelikar
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been regularly visiting The Wisdom Club with my father for his physiotherapy sessions with Dr.Manasa. And I couldn’t be more happier. I can see great improvement in his mobility and his mood as well. He looks forward to his visits and meeting with all the staff and doctors. It’s a superb initiative and I’ve found it to be one of the best eldercare services in Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: PinnedCloud
featured_reviews.review_text:
My mother stayed at The Wisdom Club for 21 days while I was travelling and she had a truly positive experience. She often spoke about the warmth of the staff, the comfort of the facility and how well she was cared for throughout her stay.

Though she’s quite independent, the team ensured someone was always present to accompany her from her bed to the bathroom or for her daily walks. She had no complaints about the fresh, home-style meals prepared by their in-house Maharaj (her only complaint was that she ate more than she usually does at home!).

Before her stay, both of us met Dr.Prem and the staff, who took the time to understand her medical history, daily routine and medications, ensuring a seamless transition.

She enjoyed the guided yoga sessions, escorted walks and creative daily activities like diya painting that made each day engaging and joyful.

If there’s one area they could strengthen, it’s setting up smoother communication systems, well-defined processes for different situations in the exploration phase and learning to say “no” when needed. They’re a young, growing organisation and I’m confident they’ll get there.

I had checked several respite and assisted-care centres for seniors in Mumbai before choosing The Wisdom Club. Like many elderly Indians, my mother wasn’t keen on staying in one, but by the end, she told them, “I’ll be back when my daughter travels again.” That says it all.

featured_reviews.name: Ramya Krishnan
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with The Wisdom Club has been extremely positive and reassuring. My mother suffers from both Dementia (Alzheimers) and PD and while I was extremely apprehensive in enrolling her as a resident at a care facility, the whole team made this transition possible. They have a great founding team and this made all the difference. Head nursing staff is very caring and they lead the associates well. Overall they seem to function operationally as one big happy family and have been very approachable. My special thanks to Dr Prem, Dr Manasa and Mr. George and Ms Seema.

Keep up the great work! Its something the community needs in this day and age.

featured_reviews.name: Sylvia Horta
featured_reviews.review_text: We found the staff to be extremely caring and the environment to be very welcoming. It truly feels like a home and not any sort of facility, which is rare when exploring options for assisted living in Mumbai.
